patch_description: This replaces soft min/max continuation with a projected contact-graph method.  Each restart is normalized to remove translation and scale, then optimized using explicit near-minimum and near-diameter contact sets.  The resulting force field pushes short contacts apart while pulling diameter contacts inward.  Multiple deterministic basin starts are used, followed by an exact-ratio greedy coordinate refinement on the strongest candidate.  This avoids relying on unstable high-temperature exponential weights and directly optimizes the active constraints defining the packing ratio.
